<script lang="ts" setup>
import { onBeforeUnmount, onMounted } from "vue";
import { createSimulatedLevels } from "@/lib/simulated-levels";
import { Meter } from "@/components/audio-ui/meter/vue";

const simulated = createSimulatedLevels(2);
let stop: (() => void) | undefined;
onMounted(() => {
  stop = simulated.run();
});
onBeforeUnmount(() => stop?.());

const decibels = (formattedValue: string) => `${formattedValue} dB`;
</script>

<template>
  <Meter.Root
    aria-label="Stereo output"
    class="relative data-[orientation=vertical]:h-48 data-[orientation=vertical]:[--meter-thickness:--spacing(3.5)] data-[orientation=horizontal]:[--meter-thickness:--spacing(3)] flex select-none gap-1 data-[orientation=horizontal]:mb-6 data-[orientation=horizontal]:w-full data-[orientation=horizontal]:flex-col data-[orientation=vertical]:me-8 data-[orientation=vertical]:w-fit"
    :source="simulated.source"
    :warn-threshold="-12"
  >
    <template #default="{ state }">
      <Meter.Channel
        class="rounded-[min(var(--radius-sm),6px)] bg-input/70 transition-shadow duration-150 ease-out data-clipping:ring-2 data-clipped:ring-2 data-clipping:ring-destructive data-clipped:ring-destructive relative flex-1 overflow-hidden data-[orientation=horizontal]:h-(--meter-thickness,auto) data-[orientation=horizontal]:flex-none data-[orientation=vertical]:w-(--meter-thickness,auto) data-[orientation=vertical]:flex-none"
        v-for="index in state.channelCount"
        :key="index"
        :aria-label="`Stereo output ${index}`"
        :get-aria-value-text="decibels"
        :index="index - 1"
      >
        <Meter.Indicator class="bg-success data-warning:bg-warning data-clipping:bg-destructive data-clipped:bg-destructive absolute inset-0" />
        <Meter.Peak
          class="bg-foreground absolute data-[orientation=horizontal]:top-0 data-[orientation=horizontal]:bottom-0 data-[orientation=horizontal]:w-0.5 data-[orientation=vertical]:right-0 data-[orientation=vertical]:left-0 data-[orientation=vertical]:h-0.5"
        />

        :value="6"
      >
        <span

          class="bg-current opacity-40 data-[orientation=horizontal]:h-1 data-[orientation=horizontal]:w-px data-[orientation=vertical]:h-px data-[orientation=vertical]:w-1.5"
          data-orientation="vertical"
        />

          class="bg-current opacity-40 data-[orientation=horizontal]:h-1 data-[orientation=horizontal]:w-px data-[orientation=vertical]:h-px data-[orientation=vertical]:w-1.5"

          >-20</span

      <Meter.Mark
        class="text-muted-foreground flex items-center gap-1 text-[10px] tabular-nums data-[orientation=vertical]:left-full data-[orientation=vertical]:ms-1 data-[orientation=horizontal]:top-full data-[orientation=horizontal]:mt-1 data-[orientation=horizontal]:-translate-x-1/2 data-[orientation=vertical]:translate-y-1/2 data-[orientation=horizontal]:flex-col"
        :value="-30"
      >
        <span

          data-orientation="vertical"
        />
        <span class="min-w-4 text-end data-[orientation=horizontal]:text-center"
          >-30</span
        >
      </Meter.Mark>
      <Meter.Mark
        class="text-muted-foreground flex items-center gap-1 text-[10px] tabular-nums data-[orientation=vertical]:left-full data-[orientation=vertical]:ms-1 data-[orientation=horizontal]:top-full data-[orientation=horizontal]:mt-1 data-[orientation=horizontal]:-translate-x-1/2 data-[orientation=vertical]:translate-y-1/2 data-[orientation=horizontal]:flex-col"
        :value="-40"
      >
        <span
          aria-hidden="true"
          class="bg-current opacity-40 data-[orientation=horizontal]:h-1 data-[orientation=horizontal]:w-px data-[orientation=vertical]:h-px data-[orientation=vertical]:w-1.5"
          data-orientation="vertical"
        />
        <span class="min-w-4 text-end data-[orientation=horizontal]:text-center"
          >-40</span
        >
      </Meter.Mark>
      <Meter.Mark
        class="text-muted-foreground flex items-center gap-1 text-[10px] tabular-nums data-[orientation=vertical]:left-full data-[orientation=vertical]:ms-1 data-[orientation=horizontal]:top-full data-[orientation=horizontal]:mt-1 data-[orientation=horizontal]:-translate-x-1/2 data-[orientation=vertical]:translate-y-1/2 data-[orientation=horizontal]:flex-col"

      >
        <span

          >-60</span
        >
      </Meter.Mark>
    </template>
  </Meter.Root>
</template>
